name: rel
description: Browse and build restartable crawlers with REL's persistent embedded Chromium sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Browse with persistent local Chromium sessions.
interface.longDescription: Control REL's app-owned Chromium sessions from Codex. Inspect service health, reuse persistent sessions, capture rendered HTML and screenshots, perform page actions, and design restartable browser-history crawlers through REL's local MCP adapter.
defaultPrompt: Check REL's health and list my browser sessions.
Capture this URL with REL and summarize the page.
Use my existing REL session to inspect the current page.
Design a restartable REL crawl for this website.
